summary: UI frontend counter display update. Reads global dword_7D0110; if it equals the cached value at this[199] (offset 0x31C) it returns 0 immediately without updating. Otherwise it caches the new value, then chooses a display string: if the value is zero it formats the string returned by UIListIndexedAccessor(0); if the value differs from the second comparison global dword_7D011C it formats the raw integer via '%d'; otherwise it formats the string returned by UIListIndexedAccessor(1). In every branch the formatted buffer is pushed through EditBufferStringUpdate and 0 is returned.

operations.description: If dword_7D0110 equals the cached index at this[199] (offset 0x31C), return 0 immediately with no display update.
Cache the current dword_7D0110 value into this[199] (offset 0x31C).

Branch on the new value: zero selects the list-string path via accessor(0); a value not equal to the second global dword_7D011C selects the raw integer path; otherwise the list-string path via accessor(1) is taken.
UIListIndexedAccessor(0) fetches the display string for index zero.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the list string into a 32-byte stack buffer.
EditBufferStringUpdate pushes the formatted string to the UI display buffer.
UIListIndexedAccessor(1) fetches the display string for the special-value index.

StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the current index as a raw integer via the '%d' format literal (packet read-global aD_1 at 0x005C3280 plausibly backs that literal) when it does not match the special value.
